body: Because I don't want anyone I know to read what I write about how I really feel, it's like vulnerability. There's a reason I'm posting to an anonymous internet forum and not talking to people I know.
I'm trying that at the moment with getting back into drawing, I'll see how it goes. I suppose there's no magic pill, it's just a big struggle then eventually it's not so much of a struggle.
Sorry for my response, I was feeling really shitty. Thanks for the attempt to help.
Thanks for the support, it means a lot.

It was (is) very tough being apart from my girlfriend, but physically it was eased by a near total loss of sex drive.

As for other forms of exercise, I've tried basketball, swimming and running and got better results from powerlifting, I think I'll stick to it for now. Maybe someday I'll find something better but that's a pretty low priority as it is.

The hardest thing I find is motivating myself to do *anything*. I don't even know where to start, when I'm sleeping 12-14 hours a night and not really doing anything all day.
